turns.goal: What food and campus facilities are near PSU Phuket?
turns.final_answer: PSU Phuket has a campus library, on-campus dormitories, sports facilities, a health service and a student canteen. Nearby food options include the campus canteen (about THB 50), Kathu food stalls 2 km away (about THB 60), and Central Phuket’s food court 10 km away (about THB 100).
